name: Magical Jukujo Kamiogi Youko
original_name: マジカル熟女・神荻葉子
source:
Yoko used to be a magical girl. She is, however, now married and lives a peaceful life with her husband and a daughter. But one day, she gets involved in an extraordinary life all of a sudden...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081108111122/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011707]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
Yoko过去曾是一名魔法少女，如今已经结婚，与丈夫和成年女儿过着平静生活。然而有一天，她突然再次卷入非同寻常的人生…

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081108111122/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011707]Eroge Shop[/url]]
